title: Exact all-replies image of the opposed-kings checking phase
scope: Exact IsKRK, strong turn, Opposed kings (same file, weak rank = strong rank + 2), four-file rook/weak margin and rook off the weak rank. The chosen legal check either mates or has nonempty replies; EVERY first reply permits a chosen legal king-up with nonempty replies; EVERY second reply has exact Matches and PhaseImage, with strict decrease of 7−weakRank. PhaseImage means rookRank=strongRank+1, weakRank=rookRank+1 or +2, weak/strong file offset≤2, rook/strong file margin≥4 and rook/weak distance≥2. This is an output family, not by itself a closed strategy.

title: Bounded upper-band rook-rank advance with immediate rescue
scope: Exact IsKRK, strong turn, strongRank<rookRank, rookRank+2≤weakRank, and rook/weak file margin≥2. Choose the legal same-file rook raise by one rank; replies exist and EVERY reply is a strong-turn Matches state, either already DistantBarrier or followed by a chosen same-rank far-file rook rescue, with nonempty replies and EVERY reply a DistantBarrier. Thus at most four plies; 7−rookRank strictly decreases. A three-file initial margin gives the narrower two-ply result. The complete PhaseImage upper band is covered by its derived two-file margin. Rescue happens on the strong turn before another weak move. No ForceMate conclusion is asserted by this local contraction alone. Fixed chase-cycle, protected stalemate, lower-band crossing and hanging-rook controls are retained as supplementary witnesses.

title: Two-file opposed-kings checking action and upper-edge forced mate
scope: Exact IsKRK, strong turn, Opposed kings, rook/weak file margin≥2 and rook off the weak rank. The chosen check is legal. It either achieves actual named-colour MateGoal or has a nonempty reply set with EVERY reply an exact strong-turn Matches state, weak rank raised exactly one and file displacement≤1. At weak rank 7 it proves ForceMate. Only this first check/reply action is covered at two-file margin; no four-ply king-up guarantee is inherited from EC-T0011.

title: Finite lower-band pursuit conditional on explicit winning exits
scope: The hypothesis LowerExitWins σ y is REQUIRED: every exact strong-turn Matches state at strongRank+1=y=rookRank with file margin≥2 and either weakRank≥y+2 or weakRank=y+1 with aligned king files has ForceMate. Under that interface, exact strong-turn lower-band Matches, strongRank+1=y=rookRank, weakRank=y+1, and rook/weak file margin≥2 imply ForceMate. The oriented version also requires pursuitFile d strong < pursuitFile d weak, for either Boolean direction. Actual distinct rook tempos, bounded two-margin normalization and strong-file advances cover EVERY defence with nonempty replies. Only the king-file-advance recursive call decreases 7−pursuitFile d strong. This bundle is conditional; EC-T0016 separately discharges its exit interface.

title: Unconditional clock-free forcing from every separated rank wall
scope: The flagship assumes ONLY exact strong-turn Matches and strongRank<rookRank<weakRank. It concludes ForceMate σ q with no LowerExitWins, arrival, initial safety or file-margin hypothesis. A threatened rook is repaired before any weak turn. Nested induction on 7−rookRank and rookRank−strongRank discharges the pursuit exits. Every PhaseImage is included. The direct vertical-entry corollary additionally assumes weakRank≥strongRank+2, rook file≠strong file and rook/weak file margin≥2. Nonempty replies and ALL defences are proved. Fixed two-file-edge, former chase-cycle, threatened-rook forcing and naive setup/capture controls are supplementary, not a proof by examples.

title: Exact ordinary KRK move interface and weak-turn capture safety
scope: For exact weak-turn KRK, weak/rook distance=1 and strong/rook distance≥2 yield a legal capture to exact KK; hence weak-turn ForceMate requires SafeRook (rook distant≥2 OR protected at distance1). For exact strong-turn KRK, a legal successor projects to exact Matches and StepM PROVIDED the source castling rights equal noRights. noRights persists after every legal move and excludes castling. En-passant flags are unrestricted. This interface does not assert unrestricted strong-move completeness under arbitrary castling flags or define a new game.

title: Restricted alternating forcing transport and all-axis wall applications
scope: For any BoardSym g (an involution preserving king distance and rook line/segment geometry), source Matches q σ a, source q.castling=noRights, target Matches t σ (a.map g), and source ForceMate σ q imply target ForceMate σ t. Target flags are arbitrary. Actual terminal mate, nonempty reply witnesses and EVERY weak reply are transported by induction on the source finite budget. This is one-way strategy transport, not unrestricted Legal symmetry or equality of distance. Oriented wall/entry corollaries apply the corresponding strict geometric hypotheses in mapped coordinates. symSwap and symAnti, axis choice from king distance≥2, and geometry from a strong-turn legal arrival are included.

title: Arbitrary safe KRK setup and complete clock-free forcing classification
scope: For either strong colour σ and arbitrary flags, exact IsKRK q σ S R W, q.turn=σ, and existence of an incoming Legal move imply ForceMate σ q. The stronger geometric theorem replaces incoming Legal by inCheck q σ.opp=false and needs no predecessor. Finite setup covers off-rank retreat with axis switch, same-rank king retreat, protected back-rank entry and preparation. No assumed winning continuation remains. For exact weak-turn KRK, ForceMate σ q iff MatedK q OR (a nonempty legal reply set AND EVERY legal reply avoids KK). Equivalently it is MatedK q OR (SafeRook S R W AND a legal reply exists). Zero-ply mate is included; stalemate and ANY legal KK capture are excluded. Every setup/reply quantifier is covered. Fixed back-rank, black flagged file-axis, and unsafe-capture controls remain supplementary. This completes the intended EC-C011 clock-free target; it does not give FIDE WDL with clocks/repetition or numerical DTM/DTZ.
